crossRefs.note: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?
Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.
But I have this against you, that you left your first love.
Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I am coming to you swiftly…
Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into…
“I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.

translations.web: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.
translations.bsb: Because of the multiplication of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold.
translations.kjv: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
translations.asv: And because iniquity shall be multiplied, the love of the many shall wax cold.
